---
title: "Cell phenotyping"
author: "LazDaria, ArthurDondi"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  workflowr::wflow_html
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: inline
params:
  input: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_INPUT", "/mnt/data/input_all")
  output: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_OUTPUT", "/mnt/data/output_mapmet2")
  # Annotated MapMetSC object (e.g. MapMetSC's <output>/spe_04_phenotyping.rds)
  # used as SingleR reference for the label transfer; "" skips the transfer.
  reference: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_REFERENCE", "")
  # Filled cluster annotation: the FIRST tab of an .xlsx (or a .csv) with the
  # columns k, cluster, celltype, metacluster; "" = look for
  # cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx / .csv in the R_intermediary folders.
  annotation_file: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_ANNOTATION", "")
  # Without a filled annotation: "none" = stop after writing the annotation
  # template (two-pass workflow); "transfer" = use the SingleR-transferred
  # MapMetSC labels as cell types / metaclusters.
  annotation_fallback: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_ANNOTATION_FALLBACK", "none")
  # Phenograph neighbourhood sizes: each k is clustered (and frozen) and gets its
  # own tab in the annotation template; one k is chosen at annotation.
  k_values: !r c(15, 30, 45, 60)
  # GMM subclustering of mixed phenograph clusters, keyed to the frozen cluster
  # IDs of one k, e.g. list(list(k = 30, cluster = "5", new = "35",
  # markers = c("CD3_"))). Empty = no subclustering.
  gmm_subclusters: !r list()
  # Maximum number of reference cells per MapMetSC cell type for SingleR.
  transfer_max_per_celltype: 5000
  # Maximum number of cells drawn per UMAP plot (one fixed random subset for all
  # plots); the UMAP embedding itself is computed on all cells.
  umap_max_cells: 20000
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Plots directory
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output, "plots/04_phenotyping")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Date prefix for filenames
date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Helper: save a plot (ggplot, ComplexHeatmap, or base R)
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, subdir = NULL) {
  out_dir <- if (is.null(subdir)) plot_dir else file.path(plot_dir, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  full_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", filename))

  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  } else if (inherits(plot_obj, "Heatmap") || inherits(plot_obj, "HeatmapList")) {
    pdf(full_path, width = width, height = height)
    draw(plot_obj)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    # base R / already-rendered plots
    dev.copy(pdf, full_path, width = width, height = height)
    dev.off()
  }
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Cell phenotyping {#phenotyping}
In this Rmd file, we will

1. run UMAP for visualization
2. cluster cells with phenograph for several k (default 15 / 30 / 45 / 60)
3. optionally subcluster mixed clusters with a Gaussian mixture model
4. transfer the MapMetSC cell-type labels with SingleR (optional, as a cross-check and backup annotation)
5. write a cluster-annotation template (one tab per k) and annotate the clusters of the chosen k into celltypes and metaclusters
6. define color codes for all celltypes and metaclusters

The annotation is **two-pass**. Phenograph clusters of a BM-only dataset differ from MapMetSC's, so the cluster → cell type table has to be made for MapMet2. On the first run this step writes `<output>/annotation/cluster_annotation_BM_template.xlsx` - an empty first tab `annotation` followed by one tab per k - and stops after the cluster-level plots. Annotate `celltype` and `metacluster` in the tab of the k you choose, copy those rows (with their `k` and `cluster` columns) into the first tab, save the workbook as `cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx` in `<output>/R_intermediary/` (or point `MAPMET2_ANNOTATION` to it) and run again. Only the first tab is read. The phenograph clusters of every k are frozen in `pg_clusters_BM_k<k>.rds`, so the cluster IDs stay valid between the runs. Alternatively, `annotation_fallback = "transfer"` (`MAPMET2_ANNOTATION_FALLBACK=transfer`) uses the SingleR-transferred MapMetSC labels instead.

```{r color-code}
for (mapmet_cc_path in c("analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R", "00_MapMet_color_code.R", "../analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R"))
  if (file.exists(mapmet_cc_path)) { source(mapmet_cc_path); break }
```

## Read data
We will first read the data that passed the [second quality control step](#qc-2) and save the count data as a matrix. Low-quality markers (low SNR in a lot of samples) as well as all IF and nuclear IMC markers will be excluded for clustering. Moreover, mean intensity will be used to represent marker expression, to average out the signals arising from lateral spillover or artifacts. As explained in [the previous chapter](#qc2-save), we are using counts measured with respect to dilated masks in downstream analysis to capture membrane signal.

```{r read-data}
spe <- readRDS(file.path(params$output,"spe_03_QC_2.rds"))

# Counts matrix; keep mean-intensity channels (drop the mean-80 variants)
intensity_mat <- assay(spe, "counts")
colnames(intensity_mat) <- colnames(spe)
intensity_mat <- intensity_mat[!grepl("mean-80", rownames(intensity_mat)),]

# Keep only the high-quality clustering markers
intensity_mat_hq <- intensity_mat[!grepl("PARP|IDO|DAPI|IF2_GD2|IF3_CD45_CD56|DNA|H4K12Ac|H3K9Ac|CXCR2|PNMT|Fibro|FOXP3", rownames(intensity_mat)),]

# Drop cells negative for all clustering markers
non_zeros <- as.logical(colSums(intensity_mat_hq)!=0)
intensity_mat_hq_wo_zeros <- intensity_mat_hq[,non_zeros]

spe <- spe[,non_zeros]
rowData(spe)$use_channel <- !grepl("mean-80|PARP|IDO|DAPI|IF2_GD2|IF3_CD45_CD56|DNA|H4K12Ac|H3K9Ac|CXCR2|PNMT|Fibro|FOXP3", rownames(spe))

mat <- intensity_mat_hq_wo_zeros

# Timepoint as factor in display order (control, DE, T1, T2, REL)
tp_levels <- union(intersect(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, unique(spe$timepoint)), sort(unique(spe$timepoint)))
col_timepoint <- complete_palette(tp_levels, COL_TIMEPOINT)
```
We are excluding `r length(non_zeros[non_zeros==FALSE])` more cells here, as they are negative for all markers used in downstream analysis.
To get a first look at the single-cell data, we compute a UMAP embedding (used for visualization only).

## UMAP (for visualization only)
```{r umap}
umap_n_neighbors <- 30

# The embedding is slow for hundreds of thousands of cells, so it is frozen in
# R_intermediary (umap_BM.rds) and reused as long as it covers all cells and was
# computed on the same channels and n_neighbors; delete the file to recompute.
umap_name  <- "umap_BM.rds"
umap_valid <- function(u) {
  is.matrix(u) && all(colnames(spe) %in% rownames(u)) &&
    identical(attr(u, "channels"), rownames(mat)) &&
    identical(as.numeric(attr(u, "n_neighbors")), as.numeric(umap_n_neighbors))
}
mat_red <- NULL
for (f in file.path(inter_dirs, umap_name)) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) next
  u <- readRDS(f)
  if (umap_valid(u)) {
    mat_red     <- u[colnames(spe), , drop = FALSE]
    umap_source <- paste("loaded from", f)
    break
  }
  message("Frozen UMAP ", f, " does not match the current cells / channels - not used.")
}

if (is.null(mat_red)) {
  set.seed(221228)

  Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1)
  Sys.setenv(MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1)

  BPPARAM <- SnowParam(workers = 30, type = "SOCK", RNGseed = 221228)

  mat_red <- calculateUMAP(
    mat,
    n_neighbors = umap_n_neighbors,
    BPPARAM = BPPARAM
  )
  rownames(mat_red) <- colnames(spe)

  frozen <- mat_red
  attr(frozen, "channels")    <- rownames(mat)
  attr(frozen, "n_neighbors") <- umap_n_neighbors
  dir.create(freeze_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  saveRDS(frozen, file.path(freeze_dir, umap_name))
  umap_source <- paste("computed and saved to", file.path(freeze_dir, umap_name))
}
cat("[04_phenotyping] UMAP embedding", umap_source, "\n", file = stderr())

reducedDim(spe, "UMAP") <- mat_red

# Cells drawn in the UMAP plots: one fixed random subset (the embedding above
# uses all cells), so the plots stay readable with hundreds of thousands of cells
set.seed(221228)
umap_cells <- sort(sample(ncol(spe), min(params$umap_max_cells, ncol(spe))))

p <- dittoDimPlot(spe[, umap_cells], var = "fm_id",
             reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 1,
             do.label = TRUE,
             legend.show=F) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Sample ID on UMAP")

save_plot(p, "UMAP-vis-sampleID.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

p

```

All UMAP plots in this step show the same random subset of `r length(umap_cells)` of the `r ncol(spe)` cells (`params$umap_max_cells`); the embedding itself covers all cells. It was `r umap_source`: it is computed once and then reused by later runs, like the phenograph clusterings.

The same UMAP colored by timepoint shows whether cells of the BM controls, diagnosis, treatment and relapse samples overlap.

```{r umap-timepoint}
spe$timepoint_plot <- factor(spe$timepoint, levels = tp_levels)

p_tp <- dittoDimPlot(spe[, umap_cells], var = "timepoint_plot",
             reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3,
             order = "randomize",
             legend.show = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_timepoint) +   # matched by name
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Timepoint on UMAP")

save_plot(p_tp, "UMAP-vis-timepoint.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)

p_tp
```

## Phenograph clustering and marker bubble plots
We source the shared bubble-plot helper and cluster the cells with phenograph at several neighbourhood sizes, k = `r paste(params$k_values, collapse = " / ")` (a smaller k gives more, finer clusters). For each k, a UMAP shows the clusters and a bubble plot summarises them: dot colour encodes scaled marker expression and dot size the fraction of cells expressing the marker; the barplots on top give the number of cells per cluster for each timepoint (control BM, DE, T1, T2, REL) - clusters absent from the control samples are candidate tumor clusters. One k is chosen at the annotation step below.

```{r vis-data-bubbleplot}
# Shared bubble-plot helper.
source(if (file.exists("code/bubbleplot.R")) "code/bubbleplot.R" else "../code/bubbleplot.R",
       local = TRUE)   # local=TRUE so the helper sees spe/mat
```

```{r phenograph-clustering}
k_values <- sort(unique(as.integer(params$k_values)))

# Phenograph is not bit-reproducible across machines, so each k's labelling is
# frozen in R_intermediary (pg_clusters_BM_k<k>.rds) and loaded when present.
for (k in k_values) {
  pg_name <- paste0("pg_clusters_BM_k", k, ".rds")
  pg_file <- Find(file.exists, file.path(inter_dirs, pg_name))
  if (!is.null(pg_file)) {
    pg <- readRDS(pg_file)
    if (!all(colnames(spe) %in% names(pg)))
      stop("Frozen clustering ", pg_file, " does not cover all cells (the QC steps changed ",
           "the cell set). Delete the pg_clusters_BM_k*.rds files to re-cluster - the cluster ",
           "IDs then change, so the cluster annotation has to be redone as well.")
    lab <- as.character(pg[colnames(spe)])
    message("Loaded frozen phenograph clustering (k = ", k, "): ", pg_file)
  } else {
    set.seed(221228)
    Rphenograph_out <- Rphenoannoy(t(mat), k = k)
    lab <- as.character(membership(Rphenograph_out[[2]]))
    dir.create(freeze_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    saveRDS(setNames(lab, colnames(spe)), file.path(freeze_dir, pg_name))
    message("Saved frozen phenograph clustering (k = ", k, "): ", file.path(freeze_dir, pg_name))
  }
  # Raw phenograph labels (what pg_clusters_BM_k<k>.rds stores); the GMM
  # subclusters are added in pg_clusters_k<k> below.
  colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_raw_k", k)]] <- lab
}

cluster_sizes <- lapply(k_values, function(k) table(colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_raw_k", k)]]))
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  k                 = k_values,
  n_clusters        = vapply(cluster_sizes, length, integer(1)),
  smallest_cluster  = vapply(cluster_sizes, function(x) as.integer(min(x)), integer(1)),
  clusters_below_10 = vapply(cluster_sizes, function(x) sum(x < 10), integer(1))
), caption = "Phenograph clusters per k: number, smallest cluster (cells) and clusters with fewer than 10 cells")
```

```{r phenograph-umap-bubbleplot}
if (is.null(metadata(spe)$color_vectors)) {
  metadata(spe)$color_vectors <- list()
}

# UMAP coloured by a cluster column, with cluster labels filled in the cluster colour
umap_clusters <- function(object, var, cols, title) {
  p <- dittoDimPlot(
    object, var = var, reduction.use = "UMAP",
    size = 0.5, do.label = TRUE, legend.show = FALSE,
    color.panel = cols
  ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +   # matched by name: clusters absent from the subset are fine
    theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle(title)
  label_layer <- which(
    sapply(p$layers, function(x) class(x$geom)[1]) %in% c("GeomLabelRepel", "GeomLabel")
  )
  label_data <- layer_data(p, label_layer)
  p$layers[[label_layer]]$aes_params$fill   <- cols[as.character(label_data$label)]
  p$layers[[label_layer]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
  p
}

for (k in k_values) {
  raw_col  <- paste0("pg_raw_k", k)
  levels_k <- get_cluster_levels(colData(spe)[[raw_col]])
  # One palette per k (stored on spe, reused by the bubble plot)
  cols_k <- generate_cluster_colors(levels_k, seed = color_seed_base + k)[levels_k]
  metadata(spe)$color_vectors[[paste0("col_", raw_col)]] <- cols_k

  spe$pg_plot <- factor(colData(spe)[[raw_col]], levels = levels_k)
  p <- umap_clusters(spe[, umap_cells], "pg_plot", cols_k, paste0("Phenograph clusters (k = ", k, ") on UMAP"))
  save_plot(p, paste0("umap_pg_clusters_k", k, ".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  print(p)

  # Bubble plot (cell counts per timepoint on top)
  plot_cluster_bubble(
    cluster_col = raw_col,
    save_name = paste0("bubbleplot_pg_clusters_k", k, ".pdf"),
    group_col = "timepoint",
    group_colors = col_timepoint,
    ncells_break_at = 100000
  )
}
spe$pg_plot <- NULL
```

## Clustered heatmaps for each cluster before subclustering

Single-cell heatmaps (up to 8000 random cells per cluster) of the phenograph
clusters of every k before the optional GMM subclustering. They are saved to
`plots/04_phenotyping/heatmap_before_subclustering/k<k>/` and not shown here, to
keep this report small. Clusters with fewer than 2 cells (or fewer than 2 markers
with signal) cannot be drawn and are listed as skipped instead.

```{r heatmaps-before-subclustering, fig.show='hide'}
genes_use <- rownames(spe)[!grepl("-80|PARP|IDO|IF2_GD2|IF3_CD45_CD56|DAPI|DNA|H4K12Ac|H3K9Ac|CXCR2|PNMT|Fibro|FOXP3", rownames(spe))]

# Single-cell heatmap of a set of cells, saved as `filename`. Returns NA when
# saved, otherwise why it was skipped. dittoHeatmap fails on a single cell or a
# single marker with signal (its zero-row filter drops the matrix to a vector:
# "argument is of length zero"), so these - and any other heatmap error - are
# skipped instead of stopping the render. Only markers with signal in these
# cells are passed, as dittoHeatmap would keep.
safe_heatmap <- function(object, filename, subdir = NULL, cluster_cols = TRUE, ...) {
  if (ncol(object) < 2) return(paste(ncol(object), "cell"))
  expr    <- as.matrix(assay(object, "counts")[genes_use, , drop = FALSE])
  genes_k <- genes_use[rowSums(expr != 0) > 0]
  if (length(genes_k) < 2) return(paste(length(genes_k), "marker(s) with signal"))
  tryCatch({
    p1 <- dittoHeatmap(object, genes = genes_k, cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
                       scaled.to.max = TRUE, heatmap.colors.max.scaled = viridis(100), ...)
    save_plot(p1, filename, width = 14, height = 6, subdir = subdir)
    NA_character_
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}

# Skipped heatmaps: listed in the report and written to the job log (stderr)
report_skipped <- function(skipped, what) {
  if (!nrow(skipped)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(sprintf("[04_phenotyping] %d %s heatmap(s) skipped: %s\n", nrow(skipped), what,
              paste0(skipped$heatmap, " (", skipped$reason, ")", collapse = "; ")), file = stderr())
  print(knitr::kable(skipped, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste("Skipped", what, "heatmaps")))
}

set.seed(221228)
skipped <- data.frame(heatmap = character(0), reason = character(0))
for (k in k_values) {
  raw_col <- paste0("pg_raw_k", k)
  for (cl in get_cluster_levels(colData(spe)[[raw_col]])) {

    idx <- which(colData(spe)[[raw_col]] == cl)

    # skip empty clusters
    if (length(idx) == 0) next

    rand_cells <- if (length(idx) > 8000) sample(idx, 8000) else idx

    fname  <- paste0("heatmap_k", k, "_cluster_", cl, ".pdf")
    reason <- safe_heatmap(spe[, rand_cells], fname,
                           subdir = file.path("heatmap_before_subclustering", paste0("k", k)))
    if (!is.na(reason)) skipped[nrow(skipped) + 1, ] <- c(fname, reason)
  }
}
report_skipped(skipped, "per-cluster")
```

## Subclustering of mixed clusters using GMM

Phenograph clusters that mix two cell types (e.g. CD3+ and CD3- cells) can be split into two components by a Gaussian mixture model on selected markers. The clusters to split are set in `params$gmm_subclusters` (keyed to the frozen cluster IDs of one k, so they can only be chosen after a first run); each entry gives the k, the cluster, the ID of its second component and the markers (channel-name prefixes) used for the split. For every k, `pg_clusters_k<k>` holds the final clusters (phenograph clusters plus any GMM subclusters).

```{r gmm-subclustering}
set.seed(221228)

# Final clusters per k start as the raw phenograph clusters (character)
for (k in k_values) {
  colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_clusters_k", k)]] <- colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_raw_k", k)]]
}

subclusters <- params$gmm_subclusters
for (sc in subclusters) {
  if (is.null(sc$k) || is.null(sc$cluster) || is.null(sc$new))
    stop("Each params$gmm_subclusters entry needs `k`, `cluster` and `new` (and optional `markers`).")
  k_sc <- as.integer(sc$k)
  if (!k_sc %in% k_values)
    stop("GMM subclustering requested for k = ", k_sc, ", which is not among params$k_values.")
  col_sc <- paste0("pg_clusters_k", k_sc)
  labs   <- colData(spe)[[col_sc]]
  cl     <- as.character(sc$cluster)
  new_cl <- as.character(sc$new)
  if (new_cl %in% labs)
    stop("GMM subcluster ID ", new_cl, " already exists among the k = ", k_sc, " clusters.")

  idx <- which(labs == cl)
  if (length(idx) < 4) {
    message("k = ", k_sc, ", cluster ", cl, " has < 4 cells - not subclustered.")
    next
  }

  sub_mat <- t(mat[, idx])  # cells x markers

  # select cluster-specific markers
  if (length(sc$markers)) {
    keep_cols <- grep(paste0("^(", paste(sc$markers, collapse="|"), ")"), colnames(sub_mat))
    sub_mat <- sub_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  }

  # clean data
  sub_mat <- sub_mat[complete.cases(sub_mat), , drop = FALSE]
  sub_mat <- sub_mat[, apply(sub_mat, 2, var) > 0, drop = FALSE]

  sub_mat <- scale(sub_mat)

  gmm_fit <- tryCatch(
    Mclust(sub_mat, G = 2, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(gmm_fit)) {
    message("GMM failed for k = ", k_sc, ", cluster ", cl, " - not subclustered.")
    next
  }

  comp2 <- which(gmm_fit$classification == 2)
  labs[idx[comp2]] <- new_cl
  colData(spe)[[col_sc]] <- labs
  message("k = ", k_sc, ", cluster ", cl, ": ", length(comp2), " of ", length(idx),
          " cells moved to ", new_cl)
}

# Colours of the final clusters per k: a k with GMM subclusters gets a fresh
# palette (shared by the subcluster heatmaps, bubble plot and UMAP below); the
# others keep their pre-subclustering colours.
k_gmm <- sort(unique(vapply(subclusters, function(sc) as.integer(sc$k), integer(1))))
for (k in k_values) {
  lv <- get_cluster_levels(colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_clusters_k", k)]])
  metadata(spe)$color_vectors[[paste0("col_pg_clusters_k", k)]] <- if (k %in% k_gmm) {
    generate_cluster_colors(lv, seed = color_seed_base + k)[lv]
  } else {
    metadata(spe)$color_vectors[[paste0("col_pg_raw_k", k)]][lv]
  }
}
if (!length(subclusters)) message("No GMM subclustering requested (params$gmm_subclusters is empty).")
```

## Single-cell heatmaps for subclustered clusters

```{r subcluster-heatmaps}
set.seed(221228)
skipped_sub <- data.frame(heatmap = character(0), reason = character(0))
for (sc in subclusters) {
  k_sc    <- as.integer(sc$k)
  col_sc  <- paste0("pg_clusters_k", k_sc)
  orig_cl <- as.character(sc$cluster)
  new_cl  <- as.character(sc$new)

  # cells in either subcluster
  idx <- which(colData(spe)[[col_sc]] %in% c(orig_cl, new_cl))

  if (length(idx) == 0) next

  rand_idx <- if (length(idx) > 8000) sample(idx, 8000) else idx
  spe_cl   <- spe[, rand_idx]

  # factor with just the two subclusters, so annot.colors (applied by dittoHeatmap
  # in level order) uses the post-subclustering UMAP/bubble plot colours
  pair_levels <- intersect(c(orig_cl, new_cl), unique(colData(spe_cl)[[col_sc]]))
  spe_cl$subcluster <- factor(colData(spe_cl)[[col_sc]], levels = pair_levels)

  # order cells by subcluster (groups side-by-side)
  cell_order <- order(spe_cl$subcluster)

  fname  <- paste0("heatmap_subcluster_k", k_sc, "_", orig_cl, "_", new_cl, ".pdf")
  reason <- safe_heatmap(
    spe_cl[, cell_order], fname,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,          # keep our column order
    annot.by     = "subcluster",
    annot.colors = unname(metadata(spe)$color_vectors[[paste0("col_", col_sc)]][pair_levels])
  )
  if (!is.na(reason)) skipped_sub[nrow(skipped_sub) + 1, ] <- c(fname, reason)
}
report_skipped(skipped_sub, "subcluster")
```

For each k with GMM subclusters, the bubble plot and UMAP after subclustering:

```{r pg-clusters-final-bubbleplot}

spe$pg_plot <- NULL
```

## Label transfer from MapMetSC (SingleR)

As a cross-check of the manual annotation and as a backup annotation, we transfer the MapMetSC cell-type labels onto the MapMet2 cells with [SingleR](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SingleR), using MapMetSC's annotated object (primary tumors + control BM) as reference, as MapMetSC itself does for the adrenal-gland comparison (`06.1_correlation_AD.Rmd`). Both datasets share the same panel and preprocessing, so the transfer uses the shared clustering channels (`use_channel`). The reference is subsampled to at most `params$transfer_max_per_celltype` cells per cell type. Metaclusters follow from the MapMetSC cell type → metacluster mapping. The result is cached in `<output>/R_intermediary/celltype_transfer_BM.rds` and reused when the reference and the cells are unchanged. This step is skipped when no reference is given.

```{r label-transfer, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
ref_path <- params$reference
transfer_ok <- FALSE

if (!nzchar(ref_path)) {
  message("No reference given (params$reference / MAPMET2_REFERENCE): label transfer skipped.")
} else if (!file.exists(ref_path)) {
  message("Reference not found: ", ref_path, " - label transfer skipped.")
} else if (normalizePath(ref_path) ==
           normalizePath(file.path(params$output, "spe_04_phenotyping.rds"), mustWork = FALSE)) {
  stop("params$reference points at MapMet2's own spe_04_phenotyping.rds; ",
       "use MapMetSC's annotated object as reference.")
} else {
  cache_file <- file.path(freeze_dir, "celltype_transfer_BM.rds")
  cache <- if (file.exists(cache_file)) readRDS(cache_file) else NULL
  cache_valid <- !is.null(cache) &&
    identical(attr(cache, "reference"), normalizePath(ref_path)) &&
    identical(attr(cache, "reference_mtime"), as.character(file.mtime(ref_path))) &&
    identical(as.numeric(attr(cache, "max_per_celltype")), as.numeric(params$transfer_max_per_celltype)) &&
    all(colnames(spe) %in% rownames(cache))

  if (cache_valid) {
    message("Loaded cached label transfer: ", cache_file)
    transfer <- cache[colnames(spe), , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    ref <- readRDS(ref_path)
    if (!all(c("celltype", "metacluster") %in% colnames(colData(ref))))
      stop("Reference ", ref_path, " has no celltype / metacluster annotation.")

    # Shared clustering channels
    ref_use  <- if ("use_channel" %in% colnames(rowData(ref))) rownames(ref)[rowData(ref)$use_channel] else rownames(ref)
    channels <- intersect(rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$use_channel], ref_use)
    message(length(channels), " shared channels used for the label transfer.")

    # Balanced reference subsample per MapMetSC cell type
    set.seed(221228)
    by_type <- split(seq_len(ncol(ref)), as.character(ref$celltype))
    ref_idx <- unlist(lapply(by_type, function(i)
      if (length(i) > params$transfer_max_per_celltype) sample(i, params$transfer_max_per_celltype) else i),
      use.names = FALSE)

    ref_mat <- as.matrix(assay(ref, "counts")[channels, ref_idx])
    ref_lab <- as.character(ref$celltype[ref_idx])
    # MapMetSC cell type -> (majority) metacluster
    ct2meta <- tapply(as.character(ref$metacluster), as.character(ref$celltype),
                      function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1])

    pred <- SingleR(test = as.matrix(assay(spe, "counts")[channels, ]), ref = ref_mat,
                    labels = ref_lab,
                    BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 10, RNGseed = 20231030))

    transfer <- data.frame(
      celltype_transfer        = pred$labels,
      celltype_transfer_pruned = pred$pruned.labels,
      metacluster_transfer     = unname(ct2meta[pred$labels]),
      row.names = colnames(spe), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Held-out check on cells present in both datasets (the control BM samples):
    # agreement with their MapMetSC label, excluding cells used as reference.
    shared <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(spe), colnames(ref)), colnames(ref)[ref_idx])
    attr(transfer, "shared_truth") <- setNames(as.character(ref[, shared]$celltype), shared)

    attr(transfer, "reference")        <- normalizePath(ref_path)
    attr(transfer, "reference_mtime")  <- as.character(file.mtime(ref_path))
    attr(transfer, "max_per_celltype") <- params$transfer_max_per_celltype
    dir.create(freeze_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    saveRDS(transfer, cache_file)
    message("Saved label transfer: ", cache_file)
    rm(ref, ref_mat); invisible(gc())
  }

  spe$celltype_transfer        <- transfer$celltype_transfer
  spe$celltype_transfer_pruned <- transfer$celltype_transfer_pruned
  spe$metacluster_transfer     <- transfer$metacluster_transfer
  transfer_ok <- TRUE

  # Agreement on held-out shared cells (control BM, also annotated in MapMetSC).
  # Row-subsetting drops attributes, so read them from the full cached table.
  truth <- attr(if (cache_valid) cache else transfer, "shared_truth")
  truth <- truth[names(truth) %in% colnames(spe)]
  if (length(truth)) {
    pred_shared <- spe[, names(truth)]$celltype_transfer
    message(sprintf("Label transfer vs MapMetSC labels on %d held-out shared (control BM) cells: %.1f%% agreement.",
                    length(truth), 100 * mean(pred_shared == truth)))
    conf <- as.data.frame(table(MapMetSC = truth, transferred = pred_shared)) %>%
      group_by(MapMetSC) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * Freq / sum(Freq)) %>% ungroup()
    p_conf <- ggplot(conf, aes(transferred, MapMetSC, fill = pct)) +
      geom_tile() +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "% of row") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = "Label transfer on held-out shared control BM cells",
           x = "transferred label (SingleR)", y = "MapMetSC label")
    save_plot(p_conf, "label_transfer_agreement_shared_cells.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
    print(p_conf)
  }

  # Transferred cell types on the UMAP
  col_transfer <- complete_palette(spe$celltype_transfer, COL_CELLTYPE)
  p_tr <- dittoDimPlot(spe[, umap_cells], var = "celltype_transfer",
               reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3,
               order = "randomize",
               legend.show = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_transfer) +   # matched by name
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1) +
    ggtitle("Transferred MapMetSC cell types (SingleR) on UMAP")
  save_plot(p_tr, "umap-celltype-transfer.pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
  print(p_tr)

  # Composition of each phenograph cluster in transferred cell types, per k
  for (k in k_values) {
    col_k <- paste0("pg_clusters_k", k)
    comp <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = colData(spe)[[col_k]], transferred = spe$celltype_transfer)) %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * Freq / sum(Freq)) %>% ungroup() %>%
      mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = get_cluster_levels(colData(spe)[[col_k]])))
    p_comp <- ggplot(comp, aes(transferred, cluster, fill = pct)) +
      geom_tile() +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "% of cluster") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = paste0("Transferred MapMetSC cell types per phenograph cluster (k = ", k, ")"),
           x = "transferred label (SingleR)", y = "phenograph cluster")
    save_plot(p_comp, paste0("label_transfer_per_cluster_k", k, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)
    print(p_comp)
  }
}
```

## Cluster annotation template

Each run writes an annotation workbook `<output>/annotation/cluster_annotation_BM_template.xlsx` with:

* a first tab **`annotation`**, empty: the only tab read by this script. Copy the annotated rows of the chosen k into it (columns `k`, `cluster`, `celltype`, `metacluster`, optionally `comments`);
* one tab per k (**`k15`**, **`k30`**, ...), one row per (sub)cluster of that k: the `k`, the cluster, its cell counts per timepoint, the percentage of each timepoint within the cluster and - when the label transfer ran - the most frequent transferred MapMetSC cell type and metacluster with their share of the cluster, plus empty `celltype`, `metacluster` and `comments` columns for the annotation;
* an **`instructions`** tab.

The annotation is made from the bubble plots, the heatmaps above, images and literature. Use the MapMetSC metacluster names where they apply (`tumor`, `T cells`, `granulocytes`, `myeloid/NK`, `B cells`, `mesenchymal`, `proliferating cells`, `progenitors`, `other`): the correlation steps use `tumor` and `other`.

```{r annotation-template}
# One tab per k: clusters with counts / % per timepoint and transfer suggestions
make_k_tab <- function(k) {
  labs <- colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_clusters_k", k)]]
  ids  <- get_cluster_levels(labs)

  counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(factor(labs, levels = ids),
                                       factor(spe$timepoint, levels = tp_levels)))
  tab <- data.frame(k = k, cluster = ids, n_total = rowSums(counts), check.names = FALSE)
  tab <- cbind(tab, setNames(counts, paste0("n_", colnames(counts))))
  pct <- round(100 * counts / pmax(rowSums(counts), 1), 1)
  tab <- cbind(tab, setNames(pct, paste0("pct_", colnames(pct))))

  if (transfer_ok) {
    top_label <- function(lab) {
      t <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = labs, label = lab)) %>%
        group_by(cluster) %>% mutate(frac = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
        slice_max(frac, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
      t[match(ids, t$cluster), ]
    }
    top_ct   <- top_label(spe$celltype_transfer)
    top_meta <- top_label(spe$metacluster_transfer)
    tab$transfer_celltype        <- as.character(top_ct$label)
    tab$transfer_celltype_pct    <- round(100 * top_ct$frac, 1)
    tab$transfer_metacluster     <- as.character(top_meta$label)
    tab$transfer_metacluster_pct <- round(100 * top_meta$frac, 1)
  }
  tab$celltype    <- ""
  tab$metacluster <- ""
  tab$comments    <- ""
  rownames(tab) <- NULL
  tab
}
k_tabs <- setNames(lapply(k_values, make_k_tab), paste0("k", k_values))

# First tab: empty, read by the script once the chosen k's rows are copied in
annotation_tab <- data.frame(k = integer(0), cluster = character(0), celltype = character(0),
                             metacluster = character(0), comments = character(0))

instructions <- data.frame(instructions = c(
  "The FIRST tab ('annotation') is the only tab read by 04_phenotyping.",
  "Each k tab lists the phenograph clusters (+ GMM subclusters) of that k: cell counts and % per timepoint;",
  "  transfer_* columns = most frequent SingleR-transferred MapMetSC label and its % of the cluster.",
  "Annotate celltype and metacluster in the k tab(s) you are considering, then copy the rows of the chosen k",
  "  into the first tab, keeping the column names k, cluster, celltype, metacluster (comments optional).",
  "All rows of the first tab must have the same k, and every cluster of that k needs a celltype and a metacluster.",
  "Save the workbook as cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx in <output>/R_intermediary/ (or set MAPMET2_ANNOTATION) and run again.",
  "Cluster IDs refer to the frozen clusterings pg_clusters_BM_k<k>.rds (+ the GMM subclusters of params$gmm_subclusters).",
  "Use the MapMetSC metacluster names where they apply; 'tumor' and 'other' are used by the correlation steps."))

template_dir <- file.path(params$output, "annotation")
dir.create(template_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
if (requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  template_file <- file.path(template_dir, "cluster_annotation_BM_template.xlsx")
  writexl::write_xlsx(c(list(annotation = annotation_tab), k_tabs, list(instructions = instructions)),
                      template_file)
} else {
  # no writexl: an empty annotation CSV plus one CSV per k
  template_file <- file.path(template_dir, "cluster_annotation_BM_template.csv")
  write.csv(annotation_tab, template_file, row.names = FALSE)
  for (nm in names(k_tabs))
    write.csv(k_tabs[[nm]], file.path(template_dir, paste0("cluster_annotation_BM_template_", nm, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
}
message("Wrote annotation template: ", template_file)

for (nm in names(k_tabs)) {
  tab <- k_tabs[[nm]]
  print(knitr::kable(head(tab[, c("k", "cluster", "n_total", grep("^pct_", colnames(tab), value = TRUE),
                                  intersect(c("transfer_celltype", "transfer_celltype_pct"), colnames(tab)))],
                          60), row.names = FALSE, caption = paste("Template tab", nm)))
}
```

## Annotation and merging of clusters

Next, we read the filled cluster annotation: the **first tab** of the workbook (or a `.csv`) with the columns `k`, `cluster`, `celltype` and `metacluster`. Its `k` selects which clustering is annotated: all rows must share one k, and every cluster of that k must have a celltype and a metacluster. The workbook is taken from `params$annotation_file` (`MAPMET2_ANNOTATION`) or, if that is empty, from the first `cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx` / `.csv` found in `MAPMET2_INTERMEDIARY`, `<input>/R_intermediary`, `<input>/../R_intermediary` or `<output>/R_intermediary`. While there is no workbook or its first tab is empty, the step either stops here (default) or uses the transferred labels (`annotation_fallback = "transfer"`).

```{r annotations-celltypes}
annotation_fallback <- if (nzchar(params$annotation_fallback)) params$annotation_fallback else "none"
annotation_fallback <- match.arg(annotation_fallback, c("none", "transfer"))

ann_file <- if (nzchar(params$annotation_file)) {
  if (!file.exists(params$annotation_file))
    stop("params$annotation_file not found: ", params$annotation_file)
  params$annotation_file
} else {
  Find(file.exists, unlist(lapply(inter_dirs, function(d)
    file.path(d, c("cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx", "cluster_annotation_BM.csv")))))
}

# The FIRST tab of the workbook (or the .csv); rows without a cluster are dropped.
read_annotation <- function(f) {
  a <- if (grepl("\\.xlsx?$", f, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    readxl::read_excel(f, sheet = 1)
  } else {
    utils::read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  a <- as.data.frame(a)
  if (!nrow(a)) return(a)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(c("k", "cluster", "celltype", "metacluster"), colnames(a))
  if (length(missing_cols))
    stop("The first tab of ", f, " lacks column(s): ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
         " (copy the rows of the chosen k, including the k and cluster columns).")
  a$k           <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(a$k))
  a$cluster     <- trimws(as.character(a$cluster))
  a$celltype    <- trimws(as.character(a$celltype))
  a$metacluster <- trimws(as.character(a$metacluster))
  a[!is.na(a$cluster) & a$cluster != "", , drop = FALSE]
}

annotation <- if (!is.null(ann_file)) read_annotation(ann_file) else NULL
if (!is.null(ann_file) && !nrow(annotation))
  message("The first tab of ", ann_file, " is empty - cluster annotation pending.")
annotation_k <- NA_integer_

if (!is.null(annotation) && nrow(annotation)) {
  ks <- unique(annotation$k)
  if (length(ks) != 1 || is.na(ks))
    stop("The first tab of ", ann_file, " must hold the annotation of ONE k (column k; found: ",
         paste(ks, collapse = ", "), ").")
  if (!ks %in% k_values)
    stop("Annotation k = ", ks, " is not among the clustered k values (",
         paste(k_values, collapse = ", "), ").")
  annotation_k <- ks
  spe$pg_clusters <- colData(spe)[[paste0("pg_clusters_k", annotation_k)]]
  cluster_ids <- get_cluster_levels(spe$pg_clusters)

  dup <- unique(annotation$cluster[duplicated(annotation$cluster)])
  if (length(dup)) stop("Duplicated cluster(s) in ", ann_file, ": ", paste(dup, collapse = ", "))
  not_annotated <- setdiff(cluster_ids, annotation$cluster)
  incomplete <- annotation$cluster[annotation$cluster %in% cluster_ids &
                                   (is.na(annotation$celltype) | annotation$celltype == "" |
                                    is.na(annotation$metacluster) | annotation$metacluster == "")]
  if (length(not_annotated) || length(incomplete))
    stop("Annotation (k = ", annotation_k, ") in ", ann_file, " is incomplete.",
         if (length(not_annotated)) paste0(" Missing cluster(s): ", paste(not_annotated, collapse = ", "), "."),
         if (length(incomplete)) paste0(" Empty celltype/metacluster for cluster(s): ", paste(incomplete, collapse = ", "), "."),
         " Compare with tab k", annotation_k, " of the template ", template_file, ".")
  extra <- setdiff(annotation$cluster, cluster_ids)
  if (length(extra)) message("Ignoring annotation rows for clusters not in the k = ", annotation_k,
                             " clustering: ", paste(extra, collapse = ", "))

  spe$celltype    <- unname(setNames(annotation$celltype,    annotation$cluster)[spe$pg_clusters])
  spe$metacluster <- unname(setNames(annotation$metacluster, annotation$cluster)[spe$pg_clusters])
  annotation_source <- paste0("manual, k = ", annotation_k, " (", ann_file, ")")
} else if (annotation_fallback == "transfer" && transfer_ok) {
  spe$celltype    <- spe$celltype_transfer
  spe$metacluster <- spe$metacluster_transfer
  annotation_source <- "SingleR label transfer from MapMetSC"
} else {
  annotation_source <- NA_character_
}
```

```{r annotation-pending, eval = exists("annotation_source") && is.na(annotation_source)}
saveRDS(spe, file.path(params$output, "spe_04_phenotyping_clusters.rds"))
message("\n*** Cluster annotation pending ***\n",
        "Annotate the k tabs of ", template_file, ", copy the rows of the chosen k into its\n",
        "first tab and save the workbook as\n  ",
        file.path(freeze_dir, "cluster_annotation_BM.xlsx"), "\n",
        "(or set MAPMET2_ANNOTATION), then run again",
        if (transfer_ok) "; or use the transferred labels with MAPMET2_ANNOTATION_FALLBACK=transfer" else "",
        ".\nThe clustered (unannotated) object was saved as spe_04_phenotyping_clusters.rds.")
```

```{r colors-celltypes}

metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype <- col_celltype
```

```{r colors-metaclusters}

metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_metacluster <- col_metacluster
metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_timepoint   <- col_timepoint
```

## Visualizations
For visualization purpose, we give the celltypes a meaningful order. If a `celltype_order_BM.csv` (`;`-separated, columns `order;celltype`, as MapMetSC's `celltype_order.csv`) is found in the R_intermediary folders or `params$input`, it sets the order; otherwise celltypes are ordered by metacluster (MapMetSC metacluster order) and then alphabetically.

```{r order-celltypes}
strip_order_prefix <- function(x) sub("^[0-9]+_", "", x)

order_file <- Find(file.exists, file.path(c(inter_dirs, params$input), "celltype_order_BM.csv"))
if (!is.null(order_file)) {
  clusternames_ordered <- read.csv(order_file, sep=";", colClasses = c("order" = "character"))
  codes <- setNames(paste0(clusternames_ordered$order, "_", clusternames_ordered$celltype), clusternames_ordered$celltype)
  # The "NN_" prefix imposes display order via alphabetical sort
  celltype_prefixed <- recode(spe$celltype, !!!codes)            # e.g. "01_CD44+ Tu"
  ordered_levels    <- strip_order_prefix(sort(unique(celltype_prefixed)))
  message("Celltype order from ", order_file)
} else {
  ct_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
    count(celltype, metacluster) %>%
    group_by(celltype) %>% slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
  meta_order <- c(intersect(names(COL_METACLUSTER), ct_meta$metacluster),
                  sort(setdiff(ct_meta$metacluster, names(COL_METACLUSTER))))
  ordered_levels <- ct_meta$celltype[order(match(ct_meta$metacluster, meta_order), ct_meta$celltype)]
}
spe$celltype_ordered <- factor(spe$celltype, levels = ordered_levels)

# col_celltype is keyed by the same (unprefixed) names, so reuse it.
metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype_ordered <- metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype
```

```{r vis-metacluster}
             reduction.use = "UMAP", size = 0.3, labels.size=4,
             do.label = F,
             order = "randomize",
             legend.show=T) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_metacluster) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Metaclusters on UMAP")

save_plot(p2, "umap-metaclusters.pdf", width = 13, height = 8)

p2
```

Finally, we plot a validation heatmap of the cells in each celltype.

```{r heatmaps-celltypes}
# celltypes to iterate over
clusters <- unique(colData(spe)$celltype)

set.seed(221228)
skipped_ct <- data.frame(heatmap = character(0), reason = character(0))
for (cl in clusters) {

  # safe filename from celltype
  safe_name <- cl
  safe_name <- gsub("\\+", "plus", safe_name)
  safe_name <- gsub("-", "minus", safe_name)
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", safe_name)

  idx <- which(colData(spe)$celltype == cl)

  # skip empty celltypes
  if (length(idx) == 0) next

  rand_cells <- if (length(idx) > 8000) sample(idx, 8000) else idx

  filename <- paste0("heatmap_celltype_", safe_name, ".pdf")
  reason   <- safe_heatmap(spe[, rand_cells], filename, subdir = "heatmap_celltype")
  if (!is.na(reason)) skipped_ct[nrow(skipped_ct) + 1, ] <- c(filename, reason)
}
report_skipped(skipped_ct, "per-celltype")
```
